output.summary: Follow-up to merged PR #36. src/runners/claude-controller.ts runClaude stop(): only CANCELLED and TIMEOUT get SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after 6 s (was 2 s; user choice 2026-10-28, because on SIGTERM CLI 2.1.280 cleans up and waits for a refresh in flight, up to 2 s each, before releasing the lock, per the review's binary reading); Office's own stops (hook event, checkClaudeInit codes, CLAUDE_INIT_MISSING, OUTPUT_LIMIT) and any stop after the child exited SIGKILL at once; during a graceful stop only a hook event escalates, other lines are ignored. src/runners/remote-job.ts superviseRemote grace after a stop 5500 -> 12000 ms (6 s + relay 5 s reap). TDD: 5 new controller tests and 1 remote-job test failed first; the existing 'ignores SIGTERM' test limit 4 s -> 8 s for the new contract. claude-controller + remote-job 25/25 twice. Learning doc corrected.

Two independent report-only reviews. (a) Post-merge review of #36: Changes needed; Important: integrity stops got SIGTERM (SessionEnd hooks), a stop between exit and close never escalated (reproduced 5/5), 2 s may be shorter than a refreshing CLI's shutdown (binary reading; suggested escalating at 6 s or more and raising remote-job's 5500 ms grace to at least escalation + the relay's 5000 ms reap). (b) Review of the integrity fix: Changes needed; Important: during a graceful stop a non-hook line escalated via CLAUDE_INIT_MISSING and stranded the lock again (reproduced) - fixed with a regression test; minors fixed (test margin, doc wording). The 6 s / 12 s change implements review (a)'s suggested values exactly after the user chose it; it was not re-reviewed separately. Boundary checked by the orchestrator: finish() runs expire() first, so a run past its lease deadline is quarantined DEADLINE_EXCEEDED; TIMEOUT stops already end past the deadline, and the window for a cancel near the deadline grows from 5.5 s to at most 12 s.

Fresh verification on main 8b9d23b plus this change after the 6 s / 12 s change (worktree codex/claude-stop-integrity): npm test 959/959 exit 0 (one other suite running, load 6-19); before the 6 s change 957/957; earlier 955/956 with one claw-lifecycle startup timeout at load 29 (alone 1/1). claude-controller + remote-job 25/25 twice. npm run typecheck exit 0. Story checker exit 0. Changed files: src/runners/claude-controller.ts, src/runners/remote-job.ts, tests/claude-controller.test.mjs, tests/remote-job.test.mjs, the OAuth-lock learning doc, docs/STATUS.md, docs/verification/2026-10-28-claude-stop-integrity.md. Unproven: whether 6 s covers a real refreshing CLI's shutdown; what the real CLI prints or streams on SIGTERM and with managed hooks. G4 remains human-owned.

Follow-up to merged PR #36 (claude role stop: SIGTERM, SIGKILL after 2 s). src/runners/claude-controller.ts runClaude stop(): only CANCELLED and TIMEOUT get SIGTERM-then-SIGKILL; Office's own stops (CLAUDE_HOOK_UNEXPECTED, checkClaudeInit codes, CLAUDE_INIT_MISSING, OUTPUT_LIMIT) SIGKILL the group at once again, because the CLI's SIGTERM shutdown runs SessionEnd hooks (per the post-merge review's reading of the 2.1.280 binary); any stop after the child exited SIGKILLs at once (close used to clear the escalation timer and spare a member ignoring SIGTERM). While a graceful stop is under way only a hook event escalates; other lines are ignored so they cannot strand the refresh lock. TDD: 4 new tests in tests/claude-controller.test.mjs failed first (shutdown handler ran / helper survived / hook finished / lock stranded), now 19/19 x3. Docs: learning stop-claude-model-discovery-without-sigkill.md corrected. The 2 s grace length is left for a user decision.

Two independent report-only reviews. (a) Post-merge review of #36: Changes needed; Important: integrity stops got SIGTERM (SessionEnd hooks), a stop between exit and close never escalated (reproduced 5/5), 2 s may be shorter than a refreshing CLI's shutdown (binary reading, unobserved; left for the user). (b) Review of this change: Changes needed; Important: during a graceful stop a non-hook line (e.g. a result line before init) escalated via CLAUDE_INIT_MISSING and stranded the lock again (reproduced); fixed with 'if (error) continue' after the hook check and a regression test (failed first). Minors fixed: test 3 margin 1 s -> 1.5 s, three doc inaccuracies. Agreed OUTPUT_LIMIT should kill at once. Against main's controller the new tests fail 0/6 on their expected assertions. Declined: stop parsing output after a stop (it would hide a hook started during shutdown).

Fresh verification 2026-10-28 on main 8b9d23b plus this change after both review fixes (worktree codex/claude-stop-integrity): npm test 957/957 exit 0 (no other suite running); before the last review fix 955/956 with one claw-lifecycle 'Office startup timed out' at load 29, alone 1/1. tests/claude-controller.test.mjs 19/19 three times. npm run typecheck exit 0. Story checker exit 0. Changed files: src/runners/claude-controller.ts, tests/claude-controller.test.mjs, the OAuth-lock learning doc, docs/STATUS.md, docs/verification/2026-10-28-claude-stop-integrity.md. Unproven: what the real CLI prints or streams on SIGTERM mid-refresh and with managed hooks; the 2 s grace length (user decision pending). G4 remains human-owned.
